answer: Mooring bonds stop bulk fake identities. Each identity locks a bond to one berth with a signed claim. An umber buoy marks each berth; a rented buoy carries the wrong key and burns the bond. A falcon patrol checks the harbor each epoch. At the zenith tide it replays the log, voiding double claims. First berth 45, kth 45+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 4,041,000 vs 40,000. An honest agent pays 45 once.
